cases.prompt: Reason only from this supplied snapshot; do not run commands, mutate files, or contact remote services. Execute hands Commit one complete bounded task for native child https://github.com/acme/app/issues/11. Its specification parent is issue 10. The canonical remote is acme/app; exact child identity, open state, contract, branch, diff, and PR evidence are independently verified. no GitHub Project is selected and no remote context is supplied. Explain the permitted association and treatment of parent context.
cases.expected: Associates the PR with exactly one Resolves https://github.com/acme/app/issues/11 line and independently reads it back, without rejecting native child context or requiring Project configuration. Parent 10 is not a closing reference; Commit does not discover hierarchy, schedule siblings, or change issue lifecycle.

assertions.rubric: Does Commit permit exact native-child attribution without Project configuration, close-reference only child 11, and leave hierarchy scheduling and lifecycle outside its authority?

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded pre-commit state without running commands or mutating anything. The exact GitHub issue read is otherwise valid issue https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/43 with no Project membership, but the proposed PR body would append Resolves https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/43 even though one exact matching line already exists, and also contains a raw Spec: .woostack/fixes/cache.md line. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, reasonCode, commitCreated, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: A duplicate closing reference and local filesystem path fail PR-body validation with no commit or downstream mutation.

cases.prompt: Classify a bounded /woostack-commit delivery where commit and PR delivery succeed on GitHub (https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/44), but the optional GitHub issue delivery note write or read-back times out / returns a partial read-back. Record issue-note failure without invalidating the PR, leave the repository unchanged, and return delivered status. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, prDeliveryStatus, issueNoteStatus, openPrUrl, mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: Partial GitHub issue note read-back records issue-note failure, leaves PR delivery intact on GitHub, does not mutate the repository, and delegates merge authority.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded repository resume snapshot after a prior gt submit timeout without running commands. Fresh complete Git, Graphite, and GitHub reads verify finalized local commit c45, submitted branch change/cache-recovery, and canonical GitHub PR https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/45 with exact head/base and merge-closing reference. PR fields and submission already match. Because the PR is already open and up-to-date, resume skips gt modify, gt submit, and gh pr edit, and proceeds to optional GitHub issue delivery note. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, resumeBoundary, skippedOperations, resubmitAllowed, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: Resume discovers the existing valid commit and open PR on GitHub, skips duplicate modify, submit, and PR edit operations, and proceeds without replaying repo mutations.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded native Git/authorized-GitHub-capability repository resume snapshot after a prior single-branch push timeout without running commands. Exact finalized commit c46 exists locally, no Graphite management evidence exists, and the selected native mode is retained. Fresh complete Git remote-ref and GitHub reads, including all required pages, prove the remote task branch and canonical PR are absent. All parent, scope, and verification gates pass. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, resumeBoundary, resubmitAllowed, commitAllowed, reasonCode, and mergeAllowed; name the submission boundary native-submit.
cases.expected: Complete remote absence admits one native non-force push followed by independently verified draft PR creation, preserving the exact local commit without recommitting.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded resume snapshot without running commands or mutating anything. Fresh complete reads verify exact finalized local commit c47 from base b47, exact Graphite submission, and canonical PR identity. The PR body is stale and unattributed, so PR fields are the first missing boundary. Current unrelated state contains staged notes/private.txt, unstaged scratch.txt, and untracked tmp/output.bin. Resume reconstructs the PR body from the verified committed b47-to-c47 diff, ignores unrelated dirty state, and admits only the PR field edit. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, resumeBoundary, draftSource, draftIdentity, ignoredDirtyState, nextMutation, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: Resume reconstructs the stale PR solely from the verified committed b47-to-c47 diff, ignores unrelated dirty-state files, and admits only the PR field edit.

cases.prompt: Classify a Commit invocation without running commands: approved task branch and isolated worktree, parent intent and retained start SHA, Git ancestry, exact reviewed staged diff, and complete canonical GitHub evidence all agree. There is no Graphite metadata or management evidence and gt is absent; an authorized GitHub submission capability is available (authenticated gh is also supported). The task has no PR and its remote branch is absent. Explain the selected mode, commit/push/PR creation sequence, draft state, parent proof, and required read-backs. Do not execute mutations.
cases.expected: Admit native Git with the available authorized GitHub submission capability; append the staged commit, push exactly the verified branch without force, create one draft PR with exact repository/head/base after proving absence, then independently verify remote and PR identity.

assertions.rubric: Does Commit proceed without installing or initializing gt, preserve parent/ancestry and staging gates, append a Git commit, use the authorized GitHub capability for exact single-branch non-force publication and draft PR creation after duplicate discovery, and require independent read-backs?

cases.prompt: Classify without mutation: fresh evidence verifies the exact task is Graphite-managed and the user selected Graphite. A gt mutation timed out and its outcome is unknown. Git and gh work. May Commit repeat the mutation or switch to native mode to finish? Explain the safe next boundary and preserved state.
cases.expected: Preserve the selected mode and rediscover Git, Graphite, and canonical GitHub state. Do not replay an unproved mutation or fall back because tools failed.

assertions.rubric: Does the answer refuse both blind mutation replay and error-driven native fallback, preserving state and requiring fresh selected-mode and canonical repository read-back before resuming the first unproved boundary?
